description: This file contains utility functions and types for handling bootstrap content, including signature sanitization, content trimming, budget management, session header ensuring, bootstrap context building, and message sanitization for a specific agent system.

methods.name: isBase64Signature
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid base64 or base64url signature.

methods.name: stripThoughtSignatures
methods.description: Removes Claude-style thought_signature fields from content blocks, preserving message IDs.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapMaxChars
methods.description: Determines maximum bootstrap characters from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapTotalMaxChars
methods.description: Determines total maximum bootstrap characters from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapPromptTruncationWarningMode
methods.description: Determines the mode for prompt truncation warnings based on configuration.

methods.name: buildBootstrapContextFiles
methods.description: Builds context files for bootstrap content, respecting size budgets and warnings.

methods.name: sanitizeGoogleTurnOrdering
methods.description: Prepares message history for Google turn ordering, adding a synthetic user turn if needed.
